about_the_game:
Welcome to Magiculon’s Tower, a precision puzzle platformer where every jump is a creative challenge for you to master the environment. Inspired by the unforgiving design of “foddian” games, a single mistake can send you tumbling back down the tower. Every climb brings mastery, discovery, and the sweet taste of progress.

In the demo, harness the arcane power of the first FIVE spells to manipulate the environment and carve your path through Magiculon’s Imposing Tower:

Fireball – send objects flying, move platforms, and launch explosive momentum to propel yourself across gaps.

Ice – Freeze blocks and obstacles in place, maneuvering around a structured layout.

Rewind – Bend time to undo a misstep, reset falling platforms, or retrace a safer path.

Telekinesis – Move platforms and create level layouts with invisible force to reshape the level around you.

Mushroom – Create a bouncy mushroom to gain extra height, cross large gaps, and bump platforms great distances.

Explore the first two areas in this unforgiving introduction to Magiculon's Tower! Every area introduces new challenges and obstacles for you to overcome. With its hand-drawn 2D art style, the tower feels alive, its movable platforms, looming traps, and mystical atmosphere crafted with meticulous detail.

Magiculon’s Tower isn’t just about reaching the top, it’s about enduring the fall, mastering your magic, and proving you have the will to ascend.
